Name: Everia's Dragon Statues for 1.6
Author: LCKa
Description:
Everia's Dragon [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2989]statues[/url] had two versions, one through Content Patcher that replaced other furniture, and one through Custom Furniture that made them an addition. But with Custom Furniture deprecated, that last option was no longer feasible. Since Everia's permissions were open, as can be seen on that mod's page, I updated it for SDV 1.6, so that more people can enjoy those beautiful dragon statues.  Only Content Patcher is needed.

The furniture is available through the wizard catalogue; I figured if anyone is close to those mythical creatures in the valley, it's the arcane expert.

The art and assets are Everia's, so all kudos should go their way. Their permissions were open, as said previously, and I tried contacting them, but their last presence on the site seems to have been several years ago. Still, should they contact me and request this mod be taken down, I'll do so.
